author: Nicole Kennedy
title: Apple’s (AAPL) Buy Rating Reiterated at Monness Crespi & Hardt

organizations.name: monness crespi & hardt tweet monness crespi & hardt

text:
Tweet
Monness Crespi & Hardt reissued their buy rating on shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a research note released on Thursday. The firm currently has a $200.00 price target on the iPhone maker’s stock, down from their previous price target of $300.00.
A number of other analysts have also weighed in on the company. Wedbush upgraded Apple to an outperform rating and reduced their target price for the stock from $310.00 to $275.00 in a research note on Wednesday, November 28th. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Morgan Stanley increased their target price on Apple from $226.00 to $253.00 and gave the stock an overweight rating in a research note on Thursday, November 8th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. set a $272.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a buy rating in a research note on Monday, October 29th. UBS Group reduced their target price on Apple from to and set a buy rating on the stock in a research note on Monday, November 12th. Finally, Rosenblatt Securities set a $165.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a neutral rating in a research note on Thursday, December 6th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-six have assigned a hold rating and twenty-one have given a buy rating to the company. Apple has an average rating of Hold and an average target price of $195.64. Get Apple alerts:
NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $148.26 on Thursday. Apple has a fifty-two week low of $142.00 and a fifty-two week high of $233.47. The firm has a market cap of $775.31 billion, a P/E ratio of 12.45, a P/E/G ratio of 1.21 and a beta of 1.23. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter last year, the firm posted $2.07 earnings per share. The business’s revenue was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. Sell-side analysts forecast that Apple will post 13.18 EPS for the current year.
In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the sale, the insider now owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website . 0.06% of the stock is owned by company insiders.

About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
